data.title: Binance Loses $5.8 Billion In Massive Hack, Bitcoin Falls
data.description: Bitcoin price fell below $79,000 as reports of a suspected Binance hack, with outflows of up to $5.8 billion, prompted Tether and Circle to freeze roughly $1.8 to $2.4 billion in stablecoins.
data.author: Micah Zimmerman
